status_of_confirmation: Already examined in the original experiments. All follow-up tests are development/robustness evidence, not a fresh untouched holdout.
placebo_matching: Choose HDB-building centers using only 2021 rental density, mean rent, floor area, lease year, and flat-type mix. Screen rental density within factor 2 of focal. Greedily spread sites. No later rent changes or prediction errors enter matching.
row_model: CatBoost residual model on existing 77 aligned rent-history features; same context rows and temporal baselines in every ablation. Native categorical handling preserves high-cardinality block/street IDs.
fixed_origin_stock_policy: For approval month t and lag L, use the exact month t-L if it is no later than the fold origin; otherwise signal is missing and encoded as zero plus an unavailable indicator. Do not fill future stocks with their realized values.
row_primary_comparison: klic_local versus klic_sector_local, so distance, standalone company signals and distance-weighted US-market/semiconductor/FX signals are controlled. Also compare with klic_nuisance and the history77 rent-only reference.
promotion_rule: Need better earlier pooled error versus nuisance and rent-only controls, better later near-site error without material whole-sample harm, robustness to US semiconductor/FX controls and spatial placebos; ultimately require new rental months and matched TabPFN confirmation. No submission changes in this follow-up.
